§6Oil Reservoir Detector§f

§aCan't find oil? This thing solves that problem fast.§f

The Oil Reservoir Detector is a cheap handheld device that scans a thin column §e8 blocks§f wide directly below you. §9Right-click§f any block to scan, then move chunk by chunk until you get a hit.

§6How It Works§f:
§b• §e"Oil detected nearby"§f (orange ping) means you are close.
§b• §e"Oil deposit directly below!"§f (green ping) means you are standing on it.
§b• Each deposit block holds §e250mB§f of crude oil.

§cWARNING:§f Patches of oily dirt or sand on the surface mark §bbedrock deposits§f, not standard oil. Those need a §bFracking Tower§f much later. Don't confuse the two.

§ePS:§f Mark confirmed deposit coordinates. A single deposit has multiple blocks, so fully extract before moving on.
